plugins.name: WorkBuddy
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI provider for WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy, domestic and international. Browser OAuth login with multi-account support, model discovery, chat execution, an accounts page with per-account quota and reset times, the international 30-credit daily reward, and in-plugin 429 / code-6004 account failover.
plugins.author: jingjingxinshang
